messages:
auditor_taylor: Hi team — for SOC2 sampling we need a small reproducible slice of API auth logs and KMS usage for 2026-01-15 between 09:00-10:30 UTC. Specifically: auth success/fail counts, request_ids, associated keystore key_id usage, and any HSM-backed ops. Can you provide an export + brief repro steps?
marie (eng-security): @auditor_taylor yes — we can produce a scoped export. Quick Q: do you want raw log lines or the processed CSV we used for incident correlation? raw is larger but preferred for audits.
auditor_taylor: Raw would be ideal for chain-of-custody, but CSV with a reproducible transform is OK if you include the transform script. either works.
samir (infra): Starting an export job now for 2026-01-15 09:00-10:30 UTC. Will include: API auth logs (authenticator service), edge LB access logs, and keystore/crypto ops logs (keystore-service + hsm-proxy). ETA ~8m.
deploy-bot: Export job started: export-2084506789-20260115-0900-1030. Status: running.
marie (eng-security): For repro steps, we'll include this in the package:
```
# fetch export from S3
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/export-2084506789-20260115-0900-1030.tgz ./
# verify checksum
sha256sum export-2084506789-20260115-0900-1030.tgz
# extract and run transform
tar xzf export-2084506789-20260115-0900-1030.tgz
python3 transform_logs.py --input auth-logs.jsonl --output auth-sample.csv --fields timestamp,request_id,user,auth_result,key_id
# run quick query (sqlite)
sqlite3 sample.db "SELECT auth_result, COUNT(*) FROM auth_sample GROUP BY auth_result;"
```
marie (eng-security): We'll also include a `manifest.json` with paths and KMS envelopes and the KMS key ids used to encrypt the export. Note: the export is encrypted with our export KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-EXPORTKEY.
kevin (compliance): For the auditor, please include a statement of custody: who triggered the export, who accessed the bucket (object ACLs), and the IAM role used by the export job. Also include the CloudTrail entry for the S3 PutObject of that export.
auditor_taylor: @kevin yes, please. Also need proof that the HSM ops were isolated — a list of HSM session ids and the signing key_id usage. If any ops were proxied to external HSM vendor, note that.
samir (infra): noted. The infra runbook will include the HSM proxy logs. We have VPC endpoints for hsm-proxy so no public egress. We'll capture: hsm-session.log, hsm-proxy-audit.log, and keystore-service metrics for that window.
marie (eng-security): One more: provide a short repro that reproduces the 503 auth spike we saw at 09:17 UTC — include the exact curl with headers and the reported request_id sample. We'll redact PII by default but include one unredacted sample request_id for traceability.
auditor_taylor: Perfect. Can you confirm retention policy evidence? They want the retention config that shows auth logs are retained 365 days and keystore audit logs 730 days.
kevin (compliance): the policy doc link: https://internal.redwood.com/policies/log-retention (we'll include snapshot in export). The evidence should include the policy version and the enforcement check (a periodic job output).
marie (eng-security): Confirmed — we'll include the policy snapshot + the last enforcement sweep (`retention-check-2026-01-10.json`) showing no violations.
deploy-bot: Export job completed: export-2084506789-20260115-0900-1030.tgz uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-exports/ (ObjectVersionId: v-0a1b2c3d).
marie (eng-security): Upload manifest + checksum: manifest.json + export.sha256.txt added. Preparing a short README with repro steps and the transform script. ETA ~20m.
auditor_taylor: Thanks — once it's uploaded can you DM me the S3 presigned link and the KMS grant audit? Also would like the CloudTrail PutObject event id.
marie (eng-security): Will DM. For the KMS grant, we will include the grantId and the CreateGrant CloudTrail event.
auditor_taylor: :thumbsup: that's everything for now. If anything shows unexpected keys or cross-account access, ping me ASAP.
marie (eng-security): will do.
